paragraphs: I've contributed to complex data projects that require robust tools and clear communication, aligning closely with Trainline's mission to help millions of travelers. In my role, I built a tool-calling LLM agent using LangChain, AWS Bedrock, and Claude Haiku 4.5, which involved integrating multiple tools for gene alias resolution, scoring-methodology explanation, and dataset provenance. This experience honed my ability to work with advanced technologies and deliver comprehensive solutions.

I also proposed and prototyped an MCP-based agentic tool in Python, leveraging FastMCP, Ollama gpt-oss:20b, PostgreSQL, and GitHub Actions CI. This project was presented in a live stakeholder demo, showcasing the potential of these tools in a Madrid-based product start-up context.
I have not used Power BI yet, but I am eager to explore its capabilities and integrate it into future projects.
